title: Thieving Hopper
move_pattern: Cycles: Thievery → Flutter → Hat Trick → Nab → Escape (repeats)
notes: Once this monster reaches the Escape move, it will repeatedly use Escape every turn and cannot be damaged further. During the Flutter move, it enters a hovering state that changes its animations and sound effects. The Thievery move steals cards from the player's deck with specific priority: Uncommon cards first, then Common/Rare/Event cards, then Basic/Quest cards, and finally Ancient or Imbued cards. The monster plays a looping hover sound effect while hovering.
